Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard is a quality consultant (*kvalitetskonsulent*) working in the department of psychiatry, gynecology-obstetrics, and chronic diseases at the [[rkkp|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) [^src1]. She serves as the official contact person for the national ADHD database, functioning as an operational coordinator between the database and the Danish regions [^src1]. 

Her role is documented in the introduction to the ADHD database's 2023 annual report, which evaluates the quality of child and adolescent psychiatric care in Denmark for treatment pathways occurring between April 1, 2023, and March 31, 2024 [^src1]. As the designated RKKP contact, Østergaard is tied to the organization's broader systemic monitoring efforts, which include tracking indicators related to rising wait times, registration deficiencies, and regional disparities in ADHD treatment [^src1].
